g.text: End-to-End Delivery Pipeline: Code Intake • Automated Quality Gates • Staging • Production • Telemetry
Triggers via git push origin main
Seamless traffic switch to live pods
• Verified: 21/21 Automated suites passed across Node 20 & 22 runners
• Security: Zero High/Critical CVEs • >94% Code coverage • Hardened container
• Triggered by: Secret leak, TypeScript error, test failure, or smoke probe failure
• Action: Instantly fires terminal push alert & opens feedback loop to developer
